title: Fix root pytest collection across worker test modules
description: Running pytest -q from the repo root fails during collection because multiple worker folders contain test_golden_soda_pmuoneq_normuon.py with the same import module name. Root optimizer tests pass, but global pytest collection needs worker package isolation or unique test module names.

title: Validate component ablation winner with multi-seed root optimizer
description: Follow up on the 2026-05-29 AnchorMuon component ablation. The single-seed worker run found -PMuonEq and -NorMuon slightly ahead of the full worker recipe at 50 epochs, while no-SODA fell behind after looking strong at 12 epochs. Re-run full vs -PMuonEq vs -NorMuon over multiple seeds, then validate the winner through root optimizer.py before changing the shippable default.
notes: Completed the multi-seed worker replay: full AnchorMuon vs -PMuonEq vs -NorMuon, 50 epochs, seeds 123/456/789. Full had best mean test acc (84.94 +/- 0.10) but only +0.11 pp over -PMuonEq; -PMuonEq was about 11% faster. NorMuon removal was worse on mean. Remaining work in this issue is direct root optimizer.py validation before changing defaults.

title: Test AdamATan2 and AdamC fallback modes on CIFAR-10
description: Add optional vector/scalar fallback modes for AnchorMuon, run CIFAR-10 comparison against current baseline, and document whether either mode improves validation/test accuracy or speed.
close_reason: Implemented fallback modes, ran CIFAR-10 HPO/final comparison, documented results

title: Run 50M LLM optimizer comparison
description: Compare tuned AnchorMuon AdamAtan2 default against tuned AdamW, AdamW-Atan2, and Muon on a basic 50M-size language-model benchmark. Use all visible GPUs, save loss curves, accuracy/validation curves if available, and iteration speed timings; commit results and docs.
close_reason: Completed synthetic 50M GPT proxy benchmark with full-budget HPO for AdamW, AdamW-Atan2, Muon, and AnchorMuon; saved summary CSV/Markdown plus validation loss, validation accuracy, train loss, step-time, and throughput plots. Final result: AdamW-Atan2 narrowly best on proxy loss/accuracy; AdamW essentially tied and fastest; AnchorMuon trails on this synthetic LLM workload.

title: Sweep fallback inner momentum for AnchorMuon WSD
description: Add the isolated fallback inner-momentum option to the current AnchorMuon WSD recipe, run a targeted CIFAR-10 ViT-5 HPO sweep, replay the selected config against AdamW/root baseline, and update docs/results.
close_reason: Completed: added opt-in fallback_inner_momentum, ran 12-epoch HPO plus 3-seed 50-epoch replay. Result: no-inner-momentum AnchorMuon WSD remains best; see workers/codex_noradam_confidence/results/root_inner_momentum_push_20260529/summary.md.

title: Compare HRM AnchorMuon vs baseline with WSD schedule tuning
description: Add trainer-side WSD scheduling to the patched HRM integration, unblock the AdamATan2 baseline with an exact local reference path if the fused backend is unavailable, run bounded LR-schedule tuning on Sudoku with all visible GPUs, then compare AnchorMuon against the baseline and save logs/results.
close_reason: Completed HRM WSD LR tuning and final comparison. Result: AdamATan2Reference+WSD lr=1.25e-5 beat AnchorMuon+WSD lr=5e-5 on no-aug Sudoku 1000-epoch replay; docs and logs saved under workers/codex_noradam_confidence/results/hrm_wsd_baseline_compare_20260529.

title: Run AnchorMuon component removal HPO ablation
description: Ablate the AnchorMuon recipe by removing SODA, PMuonEq, GramNS, and NorMuon one at a time on the ViT-5 CIFAR-10 harness. Add any needed ablation switches in the worker harness, run comparable HPO for each family, replay winners, plot curves/speed, and document contribution deltas.
notes: Adjusted protocol per user feedback: short HPO is only the selector; decisive component-ablation comparison will replay each family winner for 50 epochs because SODA effects may appear later.
close_reason: Completed 12-epoch HPO selector, 50-epoch replay, plots, component deltas, docs, and quality gates.

title: Implement true ScheduleFree+ AnchorMuon comparison
description: The completed sf_prefix_sweep_20260529 run only tested AMUSE/ScheduleFree x/y/z averaging for the first N epochs, not the ScheduleFree+ algorithm from arXiv:2605.19095. Add a true SF+ comparison for root AnchorMuon: use the local paper markdown /home/catid/screen/papers/markdown/2605.19095-schedulefreeplus.md and Meta reference code /home/catid/screen/papers/code/facebookresearch-schedule_free/schedulefree/adamc_schedulefree_plus_paper.py. At minimum compare AdamCScheduleFreePlusPaper, direct root AnchorMuon WSD, and an AnchorMuonSFPlus hybrid where SF+ owns x/y/z, Polyak LR, c_t, AdamC/SF+ decay semantics, and train/eval swapping while AnchorMuon only supplies the matrix direction. Validate against reference for AdamC SF+, pass function_value=loss to step, tune LR/weight decay/SF+ beta/r/c_warmup, and report val/test accuracy plus speed.

title: Five-seed CIFAR baseline comparison

close_reason: Completed 12-epoch HPO and 5-seed 50-epoch CIFAR-10 confirmation for AdamW, plain Muon, RMS AnchorMuon, and AdamATan2 AnchorMuon; generated aggregate tables, loss/accuracy curves, timing bars, and README/result summaries.

close_reason: Completed corrected WikiText-103 byte-level 49.4M GPT optimizer comparison with broader AnchorMuon HPO, plots, docs, and group-LR scheduler bug fix.

title: Run multi-seed WSD schedule confirmation for root AnchorMuon
description: Latest single-seed root LR schedule sweep found WSD best: root_named_wsd_lr0.012_rg0.35_pb0.9_nb0.93 reached 87.67% official CIFAR-10 test accuracy. A later fallback-inner-momentum study added a 3-seed 50-epoch replay of WSD no-inner-momentum vs WSD+fallback-inner-momentum vs AdamW: no-inner WSD reached 87.80% +/- 0.21 official test accuracy, AdamW reached 79.32% +/- 0.17. Remaining work for this bead is the original broader multi-seed replay against constant/cosine/linear schedule winners if we still need schedule-level confidence intervals.
acceptance_criteria: Commit a result bundle with all_runs.csv, loss/accuracy/speed plots, mean/std table, and README update that distinguishes confirmed multi-seed results from single-seed observations.

close_reason: Completed epic: implemented SFPlusAnchorMuon experiment path, ran all 32 mechanism combinations for 20 epochs plus AdamW and AnchorMuon WSD controls, added plots/CSV/summary and README update.
